groups.label: Elementary wall
groups.description: Elementary anterior or posterior wall acetabular fracture.

variants.label: Posterior wall
variants.description: Posterior wall fracture, often associated with posterior hip dislocation.

variants.label: Anterior wall
variants.description: Anterior wall fracture involving the anterior rim.

variants.label: Wall with marginal impaction
variants.description: Wall fracture with impacted articular segment or intraarticular fragments.

treatments.label: Kocher-Langenbeck approach
treatments.main_indications: Posterior wall or posterior column exposure and fixation.

treatments.label: Ilioinguinal approach
treatments.main_indications: Anterior wall or anterior column fracture requiring anterior exposure.

treatments.label: Nonoperative decision-making
treatments.main_indications: Stable congruent hip joint with minimal displacement or prohibitive surgical risk.

groups.label: Elementary column / transverse
groups.description: Anterior column, posterior column, or transverse acetabular fracture pattern.

variants.label: Anterior column
variants.description: Fracture line through the anterior column with variable extension.

variants.label: Posterior column
variants.description: Posterior column fracture involving ischial and posterior acetabular support.

variants.label: Transverse
variants.description: Transverse pattern separating superior and inferior hemipelvis components.

treatments.label: Modified Stoppa approach
treatments.main_indications: Anterior column, quadrilateral surface, or medialized acetabular displacement.

treatments.label: Kocher-Langenbeck approach
treatments.main_indications: Posterior column or transverse pattern reducible from posterior exposure.

treatments.label: Stabilization principles
treatments.main_indications: Planning safe screw corridors and column fixation strategy.

groups.label: Associated / combined
groups.description: Associated acetabular fracture patterns involving both columns or combined wall-column injuries.

variants.label: T-type
variants.description: Transverse pattern with vertical limb separating anterior and posterior columns.

variants.label: Associated both-column
variants.description: Both-column fracture with acetabular articular surface detached from axial skeleton.

variants.label: Column plus wall
variants.description: Combined column fracture with posterior or anterior wall component.

treatments.label: Extended iliofemoral approach
treatments.main_indications: Selected complex associated patterns requiring broad acetabular exposure.

treatments.label: Trochanteric osteotomy adjunct
treatments.main_indications: Need for expanded posterior/superior articular access while preserving abductors.

treatments.label: Planning and templating
treatments.main_indications: Complex fracture planning, imaging interpretation, and reduction sequence.
